one_line: Maharaja of Tripura who rebuilt his kingdom after the 1897 earthquake and quietly patronised science, art and education.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium build with a composed, dignified bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, thoughtful expression; medium-brown North-East Indian complexion; neatly groomed medium moustache, no beard; sharp, observant eyes with slightly arched brows; a small tilak mark at the centre of his forehead as a subtle courtly detail.
appearance.hair: Black hair kept short and neatly combed back, mostly hidden under a white cotton pagri-style royal turban with a subtle pale-gold border and a small central jewel ornament in front.
appearance.costume: He wears a late-19th-century princely ensemble: a long, knee-length, high-collared achkan/coat in rich ivory silk with subtle vertical jacquard patterns and gold piping along the edges and cuffs, fastened with small gold buttons; over his left shoulder is a soft, lightweight dupatta in pale mint green with a thin gold border draped diagonally and tucked at his waist; his lower garment is a pair of churidar trousers in muted beige cotton, closely fitted at the calves; on his feet are tan leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes; around his waist sits a simple dark-brown leather belt with a small brass buckle; jewellery is restrained—one slim gold chain around his neck, a pair of small gold stud earrings and a single, slightly ornate gold ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A rolled architectural blueprint tied with a red ribbon held in his left hand, and tucked under his right arm a leather-bound folder embossed with a small understated crest, symbolising his commissioning of Ujjayanta Palace and his administrative reforms; the scroll’s edges are slightly worn to show frequent use.

ref_desc: Radha Kishore Manikya is a dignified late-30s Maharaja with an oval medium-brown face, short black hair under a white-gold turban, ivory silk achkan, mint-green dupatta, beige churidar, tan mojari shoes, minimal gold jewellery and a rolled architectural blueprint in hand.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Radha Kishore Manikya: a dignified late-30s Maharaja with an oval medium-brown face, sharp observant eyes, a neat medium moustache and short black hair mostly hidden under a white cotton royal turban with a pale-gold border and a small central jewel. He wears a knee-length, high-collared ivory silk achkan with subtle vertical jacquard patterns, gold piping on edges and cuffs, and small gold buttons, paired with close-fitting beige churidar trousers. A pale mint green dupatta with a thin gold border is draped from his right shoulder across his chest and over his left side, tucked lightly at the waist. His feet have tan leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes, and a simple dark-brown leather belt with a small brass buckle sits at his waist. Jewellery is restrained: a slim gold chain, tiny gold stud earrings and a single ornate gold ring on his right hand. In his left hand he holds a rolled architectural blueprint tied with a red ribbon, while a leather-bound folder with a small crest is tucked under his right arm. Use a palette of ivory, pale mint green, beige, tan brown and gold, and show him in neutral, front, side and back poses to clearly display his fixed hairstyle, turban, garments and accessories.
